evaluation.criterion: One validation-selected best against defense-best1536 under the same new runtime. Fixed 32 stress games (24x3min,8x10min), colors paired, no win-until-retry. Require all scored/valid; each clock score >0.5, family-cluster bootstrap one-sided 95% lower >0.5; each stratum score >=0.5; each of four development scalar losses <=1.03 baseline. 4 clock/color startpos demonstrations are separate, not independent replicates. Draws=0.5; maxplies/invalid unscored; time/deadline failures adverse. Missing optional screens stay unverified and never gate completion/adoption metrics. No automatic adoption or shodan claim.

unique_data_goal.independence: existing source-game/family split and symmetry keys preserved; public games retain historical partitions; no final holdout opened; new metadata has source/trajectory identity

controller: off; continue all scalar evaluator layers, no handcrafted nonterminal scores

model.objective: all-layer scalar smooth L1 cp/600, exact Q20/f64 accumulation; no nonterminal handcrafted scores
model.selection: weighted validation .75 replay/.25 new; all four replay group loss <=1.03 initial defense; best plus latest two coherent resume checkpoints; development_test never selects best

state_machine.binding: run_id and run_sha256; code file hashes, not documentation-only HEAD equality

stages: audit (native/Wasm and scalar; optional teacher retained-only)

finite_bounds.acquisition: complete: 90 public records; 2 retries each; no giant archive
finite_bounds.new_teacher: complete:12 train roots,53 labeled states, depth12/2M nodes per state; no further generation
finite_bounds.arena: 36 planned tasks; at most one retry for process failure, cumulative clocks; no success-based restart

recovery: No calendar expiry; pressure/swap diagnostic only. Real allocation failure uses microbatch reduction then finite process retries and resource wait. Stop is respected.
Exact same-run resume restores optimizer, random states, sampler and update count; completed receipts and game IDs are verified and skipped.
Missing optional teacher labels are unknown; valid independent scalar labels admitted; no fake zero/PASS. Mandatory integrity, split, finite output, legality and saving remain required.
Only C1; no C2, full holdout, public-default promotion, weight distribution, main merge or deploy.
operations.acquisition: Public-domain AobaZero annotated premove root probabilities mapped by upstream 600-logit; same historical source hashes/partitions. Old defense replay and 53 direct Apery D12 root labels (including played children) preserve lineage. See docs/source-audits/aobazero.md.

round.scope: offense construction, coordination, timing and continuity; preserve general/defense/endgame
round.optimizer: fresh AdamW and warmup/cosine schedule for this round; exact optimizer/RNG/sampler restoration for every resume
round.next_round: only after explicit user direction following arena, Astra browser review and human games
